ctx.title: Samantha Ruth Prabhu, Raj Nidimoru welcome their first child: Ananya Panday, Tamannaah shower new parents with love
ctx.summary:
It’s double the joy for  Samantha Ruth Prabhu  and filmmaker Raj Nidimoru as the couple embark on a beautiful new chapter of their lives. The duo have welcomed their first child, a baby boy named Dev, on November 19, 2026. The heartwarming announcement has sent fans and well-wishers into celebration, with several members of the film fraternity showering the new parents with love and congratulatory wishes. 
 Ananya Panday, Tamannaah congratulate Samantha and Raj 
 Several celebrities took to the comments section of Samantha’s announcement post to express their happiness. Ananya Panday dropped multiple heart and evil-eye emojis, while Tamannaah Bhatia shared heart-eye emojis to celebrate the special occasion. Athiya Shetty also joined in, leaving five heart emojis for the new parents. 
 The heartwarming reactions reflect the love pouring in for Samantha and Raj as they begin their journey into parenthood. With the arrival of baby Dev, the couple have stepped into an exciting new phase of their lives. 
 Samantha and  Raj Nidimoru  tied the knot in an intimate ceremony at the Isha Yoga Centre in Coimbatore on December 1, 2025, in the presence of close family members and friends. The couple is now preparing to embrace parenthood, with their first child expected to arrive in December 2026. 
 Samantha's work front 
 Samantha Ruth Prabhu was last seen in the lead role in  Maa Inti Bangaaram . Additionally, Samantha is serving as a celebrity judge on the culinary reality show Celebrit
